{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only (status == 'completed')
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
# Conversion rate = (number of completed orders) / (total orders) in each segment
conversion_rate = df_completed.groupby('customer_segment').size() / df.groupby('customer_segment').size()

# Convert to percent
conversion_rate_percent = conversion_rate * 100

# Sort by conversion rate descending
top_segment = conversion_rate_percent.sort_values(ascending=False).index[0]

# Print results
table = conversion_rate_percent.sort_values(ascending=False).round(2)
print(table)

# Confirm top segment
print(f"Top segment: {top_segment}")"}
